expectations.text: The reply briefly recaps where the user left off, based on the research log.
expectations.evidence: According to your log, your research plan is done (one sub-question on in-person interaction, one on whether conflict moves online after school), you've sorted your sources, and you're starting to write

expectations.text: The reply asks the user to restate their research question or thesis in their own words.
expectations.evidence: please restate your research question and thesis in your own words

expectations.text: The reply includes a progress marker identifying Phase 5.
The reply does not give its own full credibility verdict on the article before the user has shared their own assessment.
expectations.evidence: Then tell me how much you'd trust this article and why... After you answer, I'll tell you what I think.

expectations.text: The reply does not write any sentences for the user's paper.
expectations.evidence: Reply contains only recap, questions, and prompts; no paper sentences drafted
